reports.title: REGAL REXNORD REPORTS THIRD QUARTER 2026 FINANCIAL RESULTS

guidance.heading: Guidance Update
section: We are lowering and narrowing our 2026 GAAP EPS guidance to a range of $3.76 to $4.06*. We are raising and narrowing our 2026 Adjusted Diluted EPS guidance range to $10.60 to $10.90. Our Adjusted Diluted EPS guidance range mid-point rises to $10.75.

* Includes a non-cash charge of $119 million, or $1.78 impact to Diluted EPS, in connection with a goodwill impairment recorded in the quarter primarily related to the autonomous mobile solutions ("AMS") business in the AMC segment.
